s.description: sequence of ints, optional Shape of the real output to the inverse FFT.

axes.description: sequence of ints, optional The axes over which to compute the inverse fft. Default: ``(-2, -1)``, the last two axes.

norm.description: {"backward", "ortho", "forward"}, optional Normalization mode (see `numpy.fft`). Default is "backward". Indicates which direction of the forward/backward pair of transforms is scaled and with what normalization factor.

out.description: ndarray, optional If provided, the result will be placed in this array. It should be of the appropriate shape and dtype for the last transformation.

output.description: ------- ndarray The result of the inverse real 2-D FFT.
